run_fuse_scale_shift_kernel_native: run fuse_scale_shift_kernel_native to apply scale and shift transformations to a tensor with optional scale_constant
run_apply_rotary_embedding_native: run apply_rotary_embedding_native to apply rotary position embeddings to a tensor using cosine and sine tensors
run_norm_infer_native: run norm_infer_native to apply layer norm or rms norm inference on a tensor with optional weight and bias
run_triton_one_pass_rms_norm_native: run triton_one_pass_rms_norm_native to apply RMS normalization to a tensor in a single pass
run_rms_norm_fn_native: run rms_norm_fn_native to apply RMS normalization with optional residual, zero-centered weight, and custom output dtype
